info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List International Payment Consent Funds Confirmations-spec
info.description: This API allows for the retrieval of funds confirmation details related to international payment consents. It is primarily designed for financial institutions and payment service providers to verify the availability of funds before executing cross-border transactions. Users can access essential information about specific payment consents by providing the associated parameters. Typical use cases include initiating secure payments and ensuring compliance with regulations regarding funds availability.

get.summary: Retrieve funds confirmation for a specific international payment consent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve funds confirmation related to a specific international payment consent identified by its unique reference number. This verification step is crucial for ensuring that the necessary funds are available before processing the payment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to confirm the availability of funds for the specified international payment consent. It should include the necessary parameters for the funds confirmation process as defined by the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning funds confirmation details.
